mutants.description: Blink timebase is held in reset while no strikes are outstanding, so it is started by the first strike instead of running freely
mutants.reason: When strike_level goes non-zero partway through a blink period, Red_LED1's first toggle now comes a full half-period after the strike rather than at the free-running phase, so the blink edges on Red_LED1 move in time.

mutants.description: Blink counter is not reloaded at the half-period terminal count and wraps at 2^BLINK_W, so only the first half-period is the right length
mutants.reason: While strikes are outstanding, Red_LED1 toggles after the right half-period the first time, then every 2^BLINK_W clocks, so the blink period it shows is wrong.

mutants.description: Loss of power-good is treated as a live fault, which puts out the running indicator
mutants.reason: During soft-start, before the rail reaches regulation (ss_active high, pgood low), Green_LED stays dark even though the converter is switching with no fault.

mutants.description: Green LED is turned off while strikes are outstanding, against the rule that Green and Red_LED1 are both lit during the clean-run window
mutants.reason: After a hiccup recovery, while the board runs with strike_level non-zero, Green_LED stays dark instead of lit next to the blinking Red_LED1.

mutants.description: Strike blink outranks the latched-trip solid indication
mutants.reason: After the strike counter trips the latch, strike_level stays non-zero, so Red_LED1 blinks instead of staying solid in the latched state.

mutants.description: Strike blink is shown only while the converter is not switching, not for the whole time strikes are outstanding
mutants.reason: After a hiccup, once the retry enters soft-start or run with strike_level still non-zero, Red_LED1 goes dark instead of blinking until the clean-run window clears the strikes.

mutants.description: Red_LED1 holds its last value when neither a latch nor strikes are present, instead of being cleared
mutants.reason: If the clean-run window clears strike_level during the lit half of the blink, Red_LED1 stays on for good instead of going off.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is made sticky until reset, like a fault_cause history bit, instead of showing the live condition
mutants.reason: After otp_state rises and then falls when the board cools, Red_LED2 stays lit instead of following the comparator back low.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is chained after over-temperature and suppressed while OTP is live, instead of being independent
mutants.reason: When uvlo_state and otp_state are both high, Red_LED3 is dark although input undervoltage is present.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is gated by run_active, so it ignores the comparator in every state except S_RUN
mutants.reason: When pgood rises during soft-start (ss_active high, run_active low), pgood_LED stays dark until the supervisor enters run, instead of following the comparator.

mutants.description: Blink terminal count is taken from the full blink period instead of the half-period, so each half of the square wave lasts the whole period
mutants.reason: While strikes are outstanding and no latch is present, Red_LED1 toggles at a different rate than LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS clocks per half, so the blink is slower than specified.

mutants.description: Blink counter is reloaded to 1 instead of 0 at the half-period terminal count, so every half-period after the first is one clock short
mutants.reason: With strikes outstanding, Red_LED1 edges after the first occur every LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS-1 clocks instead of LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS, so the blink drifts against the specified period.

mutants.description: Red_LED1 solid indication is driven by any live fault instead of only a latched trip
mutants.reason: When otp_state or uvlo_state is live with no latch, Red_LED1 goes solid (instead of off, or blinking if strikes are outstanding), duplicating Red_LED2/Red_LED3.

mutants.description: Strike level at its maximum is treated as a latched trip and shown solid instead of blinking
mutants.reason: With strike_level equal to MAX_STRIKES_DEFAULT and neither latch_state nor latch_assert high, Red_LED1 is held solid on instead of following the blink square wave.
after: else if (latch_state || latch_assert || strike_level == STRIKE_W'(MAX_STRIKES_DEFAULT)) Red_LED1 <= 1'b1;

mutants.description: Strike blink is suppressed while an OTP or UVLO fault is live, though strikes are still outstanding
mutants.reason: With strikes outstanding, no latch, and otp_state or uvlo_state high, Red_LED1 is driven off instead of blinking.

mutants.description: Running indication additionally requires power-good, conflating 'switching' with 'in regulation', so Green stays dark through soft-start
mutants.reason: During ss_active (or run_active) with no fault but pgood low, Green_LED stays off instead of lit.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is masked by any live fault instead of following the comparator directly
mutants.reason: With pgood high while otp_state, uvlo_state or a latch input is high, pgood_LED goes dark instead of showing the comparator.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is shown only once the converter has left S_RUN, not for the whole time OTP is live
mutants.reason: When otp_state is high while run_active is still high, Red_LED2 stays off instead of following the live OTP condition.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is driven by the coarse any-fault summary instead of the UVLO condition alone
mutants.reason: With otp_state or a latch input high and uvlo_state low, Red_LED3 lights although there is no input undervoltage.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary reads the registered over-temperature and undervoltage indicators instead of the live OTP/UVLO conditions, so it uses values one clock old
mutants.reason: When otp_state or uvlo_state rises while the converter is running, Green_LED stays lit one clock longer than it should. When the condition clears, Green_LED comes back one clock late.

mutants.description: Strike blink starts only from the second outstanding strike, as if strike_level counted from one hiccup before the first
mutants.reason: With strike_level == 1 (after the first hiccup, through the retry and the clean-run window) and no latch, Red_LED1 stays dark instead of blinking.

mutants.description: Strike blink is also shown during every soft-start, treating a normal start-up like recovery from a fault
mutants.reason: On a clean power-up with strike_level == 0 and ss_active high, Red_LED1 blinks for the whole soft-start when it should stay dark.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is also lit by the SCR latch readback, as if every latched trip were thermal
mutants.reason: After a non-thermal trip (latch_state high, otp_state low), Red_LED2 lights and reports an over-temperature that is not there.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is suppressed while the latch is set, as if the latched-trip display outranked it the way it outranks the strike blink
mutants.reason: With uvlo_state live while latch_state or latch_assert is high, Red_LED3 stays dark, though the header says each red indicator must show its own condition.

mutants.description: Red_LED1 patterns swapped: a latched trip blinks and outstanding strikes show solid, the indicator map misremembered
mutants.reason: With the latch set, Red_LED1 follows the blink square wave instead of staying solid. With strikes outstanding and no latch, Red_LED1 stays solid instead of blinking.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary takes the latch term from the Red_LED1 indicator instead of the live latch_state/latch_assert inputs
mutants.reason: In the clean-run window (strikes outstanding, running, no live fault), Green_LED goes dark each time the strike blink is high, though it should stay solid. On a latch trip Green also goes dark one clock late.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is masked during soft-start, as if an input sag during start-up inrush were expected and not worth showing
mutants.reason: If uvlo_state is high while ss_active is high, Red_LED3 stays dark instead of lighting. It lights only once soft-start ends.

mutants.description: Power-good LED latches on once regulation is first reached and is cleared only by reset, instead of following the comparator
mutants.reason: After pgood has been high once, a later fall of pgood (a hiccup, latch or shutdown) leaves pgood_LED lit until rst_n.

mutants.description: Blink is made a one-clock tick at each half-period terminal count instead of a square wave toggled there
mutants.reason: While strikes are outstanding and there is no latch, Red_LED1 gives one clock-wide pulse every half-period instead of a 50% duty square wave, so it looks almost dark.

mutants.description: Strike blink is shown only while the converter is switching, so Red_LED1 goes dark during the hiccup off-time though strikes are outstanding
mutants.reason: In hiccup, strike_level is non-zero while ss_active and run_active are both low. Red_LED1 then stays dark instead of blinking until the retry soft-start begins.

mutants.description: Strike blink stops once the rail is back in regulation, as if power-good meant the strikes were resolved, instead of lasting until clean_run_target clears them
mutants.reason: During the clean-run window after a hiccup (S_RUN, pgood high, strike_level non-zero, no latch), Red_LED1 goes dark when it should keep blinking until the strikes clear.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is held off while strikes are outstanding, as if regulation did not count until the board had earned its clear
mutants.reason: While recovering in S_RUN with pgood high and strike_level non-zero, pgood_LED stays low instead of following the comparator.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is shown only while the converter is soft-starting or running, so the case UVLO most often produces - a converter held off in S_OFF - is left dark
mutants.reason: With uvlo_state high while the supervisor is in S_OFF (ss_active and run_active both low), Red_LED3 stays low instead of lighting.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is also lit by loss of output power-good, confusing input undervoltage with an output rail out of regulation
mutants.reason: Whenever pgood is low with uvlo_state low (S_OFF, soft-start, hiccup), Red_LED3 lights although there is no input undervoltage.

mutants.description: Running indication treats outstanding strikes as an active state, so Green stays lit through the hiccup off-time instead of going dark in S_HICCUP
mutants.reason: In S_HICCUP with strike_level non-zero and no OTP/UVLO/latch live, Green_LED is lit although the converter is not switching.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator blinks with the strike timebase instead of being lit solid, the indicator map misremembered
mutants.reason: While otp_state is held high, Red_LED2 goes low during every low half of the blink square wave instead of staying solid.

mutants.description: The CPLD's own trip into the latch is shown blinking until the SCR readback confirms it, instead of solid from the moment latch_assert rises
mutants.reason: In the clocks where latch_assert is high but the debounced latch_state has not yet risen, Red_LED1 follows blink instead of being driven solid high.

mutants.description: Blink timebase is held in reset through every soft-start so the retry's pattern 'starts on a fresh period', which freezes the blink phase for the whole of S_SS
mutants.reason: During a retry soft-start with strikes outstanding, Red_LED1 should keep blinking. With this fault it stays fixed at whatever phase blink had when S_SS was entered, and the blink resumes only once the converter reaches S_RUN.

mutants.description: Blink phase is cleared to dark while no strikes are outstanding, so the timebase is no longer a free-running square wave and the first strike always starts on a dark half
mutants.reason: When strike_level first goes non-zero at a moment when the free-running blink would be high, the correct Red_LED1 lights at once. With the fault it stays dark until the next terminal count, and the first visible half-period is the wrong length.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is suppressed while input undervoltage is live, as if UVLO outranked OTP on the panel, when the two indicators are meant to be independent
mutants.reason: When OTP and UVLO are both live, Red_LED2 should be lit beside Red_LED3. With the fault Red_LED2 stays dark until UVLO clears.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is stretched until the converter is running again, as though the UVLO comparator needed stretching, instead of showing the live condition
mutants.reason: After an input undervoltage clears, Red_LED3 should go dark on the next clock. With the fault it stays lit while the converter is in S_OFF and through soft-start, and goes dark only when run_active rises, or never if the converter does not restart.

mutants.description: Parentheses lost around the active-state term, so the live-fault mask applies only to S_RUN and Green stays lit through soft-start whatever fault is live
mutants.reason: If OTP, UVLO or a latch trip goes live while the supervisor is in S_SS, Green_LED stays lit on the next clock instead of going dark. In the fault-free design it is dark.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary leaves out OTP and UVLO, misapplying the window-trip argument that the supervisor leaves S_RUN on its own
mutants.reason: When otp_state or uvlo_state rises while the converter is in S_SS or S_RUN, Green_LED stays lit until the supervisor actually leaves the active state. It should go dark on the next clock.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary leaves out the latch terms, as if Red_LED1 showing the latch made masking Green unnecessary
mutants.reason: When latch_assert or latch_state rises while ss_active or run_active is still high, Green_LED stays lit together with a solid Red_LED1. The design blanks Green on the next clock.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is suppressed while the latch is set, as if the latched-trip display outranked every other red indicator
mutants.reason: When the board is over temperature after a latched trip (or while latch_assert is high), Red_LED2 is dark instead of following otp_state, so the cause of a thermal latch-up is hidden on the panel.

mutants.description: The half-period is halved a second time (as if LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS were the full period), so the blink square wave toggles every quarter of the intended period and runs at 8 Hz
mutants.reason: While strike_level is non-zero and no latch is set, Red_LED1 toggles every LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS/2 clocks instead of every LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS clocks.

mutants.description: Blink timebase only advances while strikes are outstanding and is frozen (not cleared) otherwise, so it is no longer free-running and keeps its phase from one strike episode to the next
mutants.reason: When strikes appear, the Red_LED1 blink starts from wherever the counter stopped (counter 0 after reset, or the remainder left by the previous episode), not at the free-running phase. Its edges come at different clocks from the intended design.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is shown only while the converter is soft-starting or running, so an OTP that holds the converter off in S_OFF or S_HICCUP leaves Red_LED2 dark
mutants.reason: With otp_state high while neither ss_active nor run_active is set, which is the normal case during a thermal shutdown, Red_LED2 is 0 instead of 1.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is cleared only when the converter is back in S_RUN, treating it as a thermal-shutdown history to keep until restart, instead of showing the live OTP condition
mutants.reason: After otp_state falls while the converter is in S_OFF, S_HICCUP or S_SS, Red_LED2 stays lit until run_active rises, though the board is no longer too hot.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is made a brown-out history bit, set by UVLO and cleared only by reset, instead of following the live input-undervoltage condition
mutants.reason: After any uvlo_state pulse, Red_LED3 stays at 1 after the input recovers and until rst_n, instead of going back to 0 one clock after uvlo_state falls.

mutants.description: Strike blink is taken from the half-period counter's MSB instead of from the toggled blink square wave, so the pattern repeats every half-period with an uneven duty cycle
mutants.reason: Whenever strikes are outstanding and no latch is present, Red_LED1 turns on and off at twice the intended rate and is lit for only part of each half-period (about 2.06 M of 6.25 M clocks at the default setting), instead of being a 50% square wave with period 2*LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS.

mutants.description: Blink is toggled as the counter leaves zero, at the start of each half-period instead of at its terminal count, so the first half-period after reset lasts one clock
mutants.reason: After reset the blink phase is shifted by LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS-1 clocks: if strikes are outstanding, Red_LED1 lights one clock after reset instead of a full half-period later, and every later edge of the strike blink comes early by that amount.

mutants.description: Blink timebase only counts while the converter is switching (S_SS or S_RUN), as if it shared the converter's enable, so it stops in S_OFF and S_HICCUP instead of running freely
mutants.reason: During the hiccup off-time strikes are outstanding but the converter is not switching. The counter freezes, so Red_LED1 stays at its last blink level, solid on or dark, for the whole hiccup instead of blinking.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is held dark during soft-start, as if the comparator could not be trusted until the ramp finishes, instead of following it in every state
mutants.reason: If the power-good comparator asserts while the supervisor is still in S_SS, pgood_LED stays dark until the converter enters S_RUN. It should light on the next clock.

mutants.description: Latched-trip solid indication is shown only while strikes are outstanding, misreading 'after a latch strike_level stays non-zero' as 'every latch comes with strikes', so a latch tripped by the hardware OVP path with no hiccup history is not shown
mutants.reason: When latch_state rises while strike_level is zero (an SCR trip from the external OVP comparator, not the strike counter), Red_LED1 stays dark instead of lit solid.

mutants.description: Green_LED blinks with the strike timebase during soft-start instead of being lit solid whenever the converter is switching unfaulted, the indicator map misremembered
mutants.reason: With ss_active high, no live fault, and blink in its dark half, Green_LED goes dark where it should be lit; it toggles at the blink rate through every soft-start.

mutants.description: Green's fault summary ignores input undervoltage during soft-start, treating an input sag under start-up inrush as expected rather than a live fault
mutants.reason: With ss_active high and uvlo_state high (and no other fault), Green_LED stays lit instead of going dark; in the full design this shows as Green lit on the clock UVLO arrives in S_SS.

mutants.description: Power-good LED samples the comparator only while the converter is switching and holds its last reading otherwise, as if the comparator were meaningless with the converter off, instead of following it in every state
mutants.reason: If the converter leaves S_RUN (fault, hiccup or disable) with pgood high and pgood then falls, pgood_LED stays lit through S_OFF/S_HICCUP/S_LATCHED instead of going dark; likewise a pgood change while not switching is not shown.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is also lit for the whole of S_RUN, on the belief that the supervisor only reaches S_RUN once the rail is in regulation, instead of following the comparator alone
mutants.reason: With run_active high and pgood low (the rail drops out of regulation while the converter is in S_RUN), pgood_LED stays lit instead of going dark on the next clock.

mutants.description: Outstanding strikes are shown solid while the converter is not switching (hiccup off-time, S_OFF) and blink only during the retry and run, so Red_LED1 looks like a latched trip during every hiccup
mutants.reason: With strike_level non-zero, no latch, and ss_active and run_active both low (S_HICCUP), Red_LED1 stays solidly lit instead of following the blink square wave.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator blinks with the strike timebase instead of being lit solid while input UVLO is live, the indicator map misremembered
mutants.reason: While uvlo_state stays high for longer than one blink half-period, Red_LED3 turns off and on with the blink square wave instead of staying lit.

mutants.description: When strikes clear, Red_LED1 stays lit to the end of the current lit blink half-period, to 'finish the pattern cleanly', instead of going dark on the next clock
mutants.reason: Suppose clean_run_target cycles clear strike_level while the blink is in its lit half. Red_LED1 then stays high for up to a whole half-period (125 ms) after strike_level reaches zero, when it should drop one clock later.

mutants.description: Running indication is held dark during a retry soft-start while strikes are outstanding, as if a retry were not yet 'running', though Green must be lit in S_SS and S_RUN whenever no fault is live
mutants.reason: After a hiccup, the converter retries through S_SS with strike_level non-zero and no live fault. Green_LED stays dark for that whole soft-start and lights only on entry to S_RUN, when it should be lit for the whole retry soft-start too.

mutants.description: While strikes are outstanding, Green_LED flashes in antiphase with the Red_LED1 strike blink instead of staying solid, because the designer read 'show both' as 'alternate them'
mutants.reason: During the clean-run window (strike_level non-zero, S_SS or S_RUN, no live fault), Green_LED goes dark on every lit half of the blink, where the header requires Green and Red_LED1 to be lit together.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is driven by the coarse any-fault summary instead of the OTP condition alone
mutants.reason: When UVLO is live or the latch is set (latch_state or latch_assert) and OTP is not, Red_LED2 lights and reports over-temperature that is not there.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is also lit by the SCR latch readback, as if a latched board had lost its input
mutants.reason: When latch_state is set and input UVLO is not live, Red_LED3 lights next to the solid Red_LED1, which falsely reports input undervoltage.

mutants.description: Power-good LED samples the comparator only at each blink half-period terminal count, to hide chatter, instead of following it on every clock
mutants.reason: A change on pgood reaches pgood_LED up to LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS clocks late, and a pgood pulse or dropout shorter than a half-period that falls between terminal counts never shows.

mutants.description: Strike blink stops as soon as the supervisor re-enters S_RUN, as if a successful retry ended the strikes, instead of lasting through the clean-run window until clean_run_target clears strike_level
mutants.reason: After a hiccup, once the retry's soft-start ends and run_active rises while strike_level is still non-zero, Red_LED1 goes dark at once instead of blinking for about a second. It still blinks in S_HICCUP and S_SS.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is suppressed while the output is in regulation, as if an input UVLO with the rail still good had to be a comparator glitch
mutants.reason: If debounced uvlo_state rises while pgood is still high (the output holding up as the input sags, before the supervisor shuts down), Red_LED3 stays dark. It lights only after pgood falls, although it should follow uvlo_state directly.

mutants.description: Latched-trip solid indication is made sticky until reset (the SCR 'cannot be un-tripped'), so once Red_LED1 is lit with no strikes outstanding it never clears from the latch inputs
mutants.reason: If latch_state rises from the hardware path without latch_assert or strikes, then the debounced readback falls again, Red_LED1 stays solid until rst_n instead of going dark. Also, any lit strike-blink half that is showing when strike_level clears holds Red_LED1 on indefinitely.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is updated only at each blink half-period terminal count, to keep it in step with the panel blink, instead of following the live OTP condition on every clock
mutants.reason: When otp_state rises or falls, Red_LED2 changes only at the next blink terminal count, up to a half-period late, and an OTP pulse between two terminal counts is never shown.

mutants.description: Power-good LED is held dark while the latch is set or being asserted, as if a board that has given up could not be in regulation, instead of following the comparator straight through
mutants.reason: With latch_state or latch_assert high and pgood high, pgood_LED is 0 where the design says it must be 1. No other fault input changes it.

mutants.description: Outstanding strikes are shown solid while the converter is switching (the retry soft-start and the clean-run window) and blink only during the hiccup off-time, because the designer read 'working through a problem' as the hiccup itself
mutants.reason: With strike_level non-zero and no latch, Red_LED1 stays lit solid through S_SS and the whole clean-run part of S_RUN instead of following blink. From the front panel this looks the same as a latched trip, although the board is recovering.

mutants.description: Green_LED is updated only while the converter is switching and keeps its last value in S_OFF, S_HICCUP and S_LATCHED, instead of going dark whenever the converter is not switching
mutants.reason: A window trip is left out of currently_faulted, so it takes the supervisor from S_RUN to S_HICCUP while Green_LED is lit. With this fault Green_LED then stays lit through the whole hiccup off-time. It also stays lit in S_OFF after a fault-free shutdown.

mutants.description: Strike blink is shown only while exactly one strike is outstanding, as if strike_level were a single strike flag rather than a count
mutants.reason: If a second hiccup happens before clean_run_target clears the strikes, strike_level reaches 2 or more. Red_LED1 then goes dark instead of blinking, while strikes are still outstanding and no latch is set.

mutants.description: The strike blink takes the blink wave's next value (it looks ahead at the half-period terminal count) to 'make up for' Red_LED1's register stage, so the displayed pattern runs one clock ahead of the blink timebase
mutants.reason: While strikes are outstanding and no latch is set, every Red_LED1 edge comes one clock earlier than the registered blink square wave, and a strike that appears on the terminal-count clock shows the phase after the toggle. The lit and dark halves stay the right length, but they are shifted against the timebase.

mutants.description: Latched-trip solid indication waits until the supervisor has left the switching states, as if a latch only counted once the converter had stopped, so the CPLD's own trip in S_SS/S_RUN is not shown solid at once
mutants.reason: When latch_assert (or latch_state) rises while ss_active or run_active is still high, Red_LED1 shows the strike blink or stays dark instead of going solid on the next clock. It goes solid only after the supervisor leaves S_SS/S_RUN.

mutants.description: Undervoltage indicator is shown only while the converter is not switching, as if input UVLO only mattered once it was holding the converter off
mutants.reason: If uvlo_state rises while the supervisor is in S_SS or S_RUN, Red_LED3 stays dark until the supervisor leaves those states, though the header says it follows the input undervoltage condition.

mutants.description: Live-fault mask on Green is applied only during soft-start, because the designer stretched the window-trip argument ('a fault takes the supervisor out of S_RUN on the next edge') to cover every fault in S_RUN
mutants.reason: When OTP, UVLO, latch_state or latch_assert goes live while run_active is high, Green_LED stays lit until the supervisor leaves S_RUN, instead of going dark on the next clock.

mutants.description: Over-temperature is treated as a terminal latched trip and lights Red_LED1 solid, as if a thermal shutdown always fired the SCR
mutants.reason: While otp_state is live and no latch is set, Red_LED1 is lit solid instead of dark, or instead of blinking when strikes are outstanding. This hides the strike pattern and shows a non-latched OTP as a board that has given up.

mutants.description: The latched-trip solid indication gives way to a live over-temperature, as if a thermal latch were already explained by Red_LED2, so Red_LED1 is not solid while OTP is live
mutants.reason: With the latch set (latch_state or latch_assert) and otp_state high, Red_LED1 falls to the strike branch. It blinks if strikes are outstanding and is dark if none are, where it should be solid. It becomes solid only once the board cools.

mutants.description: Green_LED, once dark in S_RUN, is relit only by a new soft-start, as if 'running unfaulted' meant 'unfaulted since the last start' instead of 'no fault live now'
mutants.reason: If a live fault (OTP, UVLO or latch) rises and clears while run_active stays high, Green_LED should relight on the next clock but stays dark until ss_active is asserted again. Green_LED also never lights if run_active is asserted without a soft-start first.

mutants.description: Over-temperature indicator is held lit after the board cools for as long as the SCR readback is set, to keep a thermal latch's cause on the panel, which mixes up the fault_cause history with the live condition
mutants.reason: After OTP rises and then clears while latch_state is high, Red_LED2 stays lit until latch_state drops. It should go dark on the clock after otp_state falls.

mutants.description: Once pgood_LED is lit, it stays lit through comparator dropouts for as long as the supervisor is in S_RUN. The designer assumed the supervisor's window trip would catch a real loss of regulation, so the LED goes dark only on leaving S_RUN instead of following the comparator.
mutants.reason: With run_active high and pgood_LED lit, a fall of pgood leaves pgood_LED lit until run_active falls. In the original it goes dark on the next clock.

mutants.description: Red_LED2 (over-temperature) stays lit after OTP clears for as long as hiccup strikes are outstanding. The 'recently troubled' persistence meant for the Red_LED1 strike blink is applied to the thermal indicator as well, instead of showing only the live OTP condition.
mutants.reason: If otp_state falls while strike_level is non-zero, Red_LED2 stays lit until strike_level returns to zero. In the original it goes dark one clock after otp_state falls.

mutants.description: The strike blink is turned off whenever Green_LED is lit, so a board that is visibly running shows only one indicator. This breaks the header rule that Green and Red_LED1 are both lit during the clean-run window.
mutants.reason: With strikes outstanding, no fault live and the converter in S_SS or S_RUN (Green_LED lit), Red_LED1 stays dark instead of blinking. If a live fault keeps Green dark in those states, the blink still shows. That second case is what separates this from the 'only while not switching' mutant.

withdrawn.description: Blink timebase is frozen while the latch is set, on the reasoning that the solid latched indication masks the blink anyway, so it no longer runs freely
withdrawn.reason: While a latch input is high, the blink counter holds its value. Once the latch inputs drop with strikes still outstanding, the Red_LED1 blink is phase-shifted by the time spent latched, and the half-period that was cut off by the latch lasts longer than it should.
withdrawn.withdrawn: equivalent on the board: while the latch is set Red_LED1 is solid whatever blink does, and the latch (SCR and latch_assert) clears only through the drain button wired to rst_n, which also resets the blink timebase, so the frozen count never reaches an output
